-- Select announcement list for operation input screens. SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, a.public_code AS announcement_code, a.target_type_code, a.title, a.agency_name, a.application_start_date, a.application_end_date, a.manual_status_code, a.approval_status_code, a.min_amount, a.max_amount, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM announcements a
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count announcements for paginated list. SELECT count(1) FROM announcements a

-- Select announcement details by primary key. SELECT a.id AS announcement_id, a.public_code AS announcement_code, a.target_type_code, a.title, a.agency_name, a.summary, a.application_start_date, a.application_end_date, a.manual_status_code, a.approval_status_code, a.income_judgement_code, a.min_amount, a.max_amount, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM announcements a WHERE a.id = #{announcementId}

-- Select announcement option codes. SELECT ao.option_group_code, ao.option_code FROM announcement_options ao WHERE ao.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY ao.option_group_code ASC, ao.option_code ASC

-- Select industry include and exclude conditions. SELECT aic.condition_type_code, aic.ksic_code FROM announcement_industry_conditions aic WHERE aic.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY aic.condition_type_code ASC, aic.ksic_code ASC

-- Select numeric eligibility conditions. SELECT anc.condition_scope_code, anc.condition_key, anc.comparator_code, anc.value_number, anc.min_number, anc.max_number, anc.unit_code FROM announcement_numeric_conditions anc WHERE anc.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY anc.condition_scope_code ASC, anc.condition_key ASC

-- Select option eligibility conditions. SELECT aoc.condition_scope_code, aoc.condition_key, aoc.option_code, aoc.option_text FROM announcement_option_conditions aoc WHERE aoc.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY aoc.condition_scope_code ASC, aoc.condition_key ASC, aoc.option_code ASC

-- Select announcement-level document requirements. SELECT adr.document_type_code, adr.is_required, adr.sort_order FROM announcement_document_requirements adr WHERE adr.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY adr.sort_order ASC, adr.document_type_code ASC

-- Select announcement progress steps. SELECT aps.id AS step_id, aps.step_order, aps.step_name, aps.guide_message, aps.action_guide, aps.completion_condition_code, aps.next_condition_code, aps.is_active FROM announcement_progress_steps aps WHERE aps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC

-- Select progress step document requirements. SELECT asd.step_id, asd.document_type_code, asd.is_required, asd.sort_order FROM announcement_step_documents asd INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.id = asd.step_id WHERE aps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, asd.sort_order ASC, asd.document_type_code ASC

-- Select progress step buttons. SELECT asb.step_id, asb.button_code, asb.button_label, asb.button_action_code, asb.next_step_id, asb.sort_order FROM announcement_step_buttons asb INNER JOIN announcement_progress_steps aps ON aps.id = asb.step_id WHERE aps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} ORDER BY aps.step_order ASC, asb.sort_order ASC, asb.button_code ASC

INSERT INTO announcements ( id, target_type_code, title, agency_name, summary, application_start_date, application_end_date, income_judgement_code, min_amount, max_amount, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{targetTypeCode}, #{title}, #{agencyName}, #{summary}, #{applicationStartDate}, #{applicationEndDate}, #{incomeJudgementCode}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update announcement base information. UPDATE announcements SET target_type_code = #{targetTypeCode}, title = #{title}, agency_name = #{agencyName}, summary = #{summary}, application_start_date = #{applicationStartDate}, application_end_date = #{applicationEndDate}, income_judgement_code = #{incomeJudgementCode}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, max_amount = #{maxAmount}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
-- Update announcement manual operating status. UPDATE announcements SET manual_status_code = #{manualStatusCode}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{announcementId}
mapper.insert: -- Insert manual status change history. INSERT INTO announcement_status_histories ( announcement_id, before_status_code, after_status_code, reason, changed_by ) VALUES ( #{announcementId}, #{beforeStatusCode}, #{afterStatusCode}, #{reason}, #{changedBy} )
mapper.select: -- Count open approval requests for an announcement. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_approval_requests aar WHERE aar.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND aar.approval_status_code = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.insert: -- Insert approval request before an announcement can be approved. INSERT INTO announcement_approval_requests ( announcement_id, requested_by, approval_status_code, request_note, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{announcementId}, #{actorUserId}, 'REQUESTED', #{requestNote}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Apply approval decision to the latest open approval request. UPDATE announcement_approval_requests SET approval_status_code = #{approvalStatusCode}, decision_note = #{decisionNote}, decided_by = #{actorUserId}, decided_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ( SELECT aar.id FROM announcement_approval_requests aar WHERE aar.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND aar.approval_status_code = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY aar.requested_at DESC, aar.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

-- Update announcement approval status after request or decision. UPDATE announcements SET approval_status_code = #{approvalStatusCode}, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{announcementId}
